I am 50 years old and I never went to school. I learned farming from my mother and from watching the neighbors. My family has 6.5 mu of land. We plant wheat in the fall and maize in the summer on 5 mu. The other 1.5 mu I grow cotton because my neighbor Lao Wang has done it for years and he gets good money.

It is spring now. The wheat went in last October. Last year I put one bag of compound fertilizer on each mu at sowing time — the bag says 18-18-9, that is what the dealer sells. This spring, when the wheat turns green, I will spread 100 jin of ammonium bicarbonate per mu. One bag of compound and one bag of ammonium bicarbonate per mu. That is what I have always done. I do not want the wheat to go hungry. If I use too little, the heads are small and I lose money. Wasting a little fertilizer is better than a bad harvest. I will irrigate three times: once now, once when the wheat is jointing, and once when the grain is filling. I spray for insects four times and use herbicide once. If I see disease, I spray once more. I expect about 1000 jin per mu.

After we cut the wheat in early June, I plant hybrid maize. I buy the seed in small packages, one package per mu. I use no-tillage planting because everyone does that now and it saves diesel. At sowing I put 80 jin of 28-6-6 compound fertilizer per mu. I do not topdress maize because I am busy with the cotton and the compound is enough. I will irrigate twice if the rain does not come. I spray for insects three times, use herbicide once, and growth regulator twice so the stalks do not get too tall. Last year I got about 1100 jin per mu. I hope for the same.

For cotton, on the 1.5 mu, I rotary till and plant in late April. I use the improved variety Guoxinmian, same as last year. I put 100 jin of 15-15-15 compound fertilizer per mu and 40 jin of urea per mu. Cotton needs a lot of spraying. I will spray insecticide 10 times, fungicide 2 times, growth regulator 2 times, and herbicide once. That is 15 times I go out with the sprayer. I irrigate three times. It is a lot of work but the cotton price is okay. I expect about 550 jin of seed cotton per mu.

My son works in the city and sends some money home, but fertilizer and medicine are expensive. I count every yuan. Still, I would rather spend a bit more on fertilizer than risk losing the crop. I watch what the neighbors do. If Lao Wang puts one bag per mu, I put one bag per mu. I do not try new things unless I see them work first.
